#
# Overlay CMake build for Lua 5.4.
#
# The upstream Lua distribution ships only a hand-written makefile, so this
# target compiles the interpreter core (minus the standalone `lua` and `luac`
# programs) into a static library for fcitx5-lua to embed.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(lua C)

set(LUA_SOURCE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../lua"
    CACHE PATH "Lua source root")

if(NOT EXISTS "${LUA_SOURCE_DIR}/lua.h")
  # Releases unpack into a versioned subdirectory; tolerate that layout too.
  file(GLOB _lua_h "${LUA_SOURCE_DIR}/*/lua.h")
  if(_lua_h)
    get_filename_component(LUA_SOURCE_DIR "${_lua_h}" DIRECTORY)
  else()
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Lua sources not found at ${LUA_SOURCE_DIR}")
  endif()
endif()

file(GLOB LUA_SOURCES "${LUA_SOURCE_DIR}/*.c")
# `lua.c` and `luac.c` each define main(); `onelua.c` is the amalgamation.
list(REMOVE_ITEM LUA_SOURCES
  "${LUA_SOURCE_DIR}/lua.c"
  "${LUA_SOURCE_DIR}/luac.c"
  "${LUA_SOURCE_DIR}/onelua.c")

if(NOT LUA_SOURCES)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "no Lua sources found under ${LUA_SOURCE_DIR}")
endif()

add_library(lua STATIC ${LUA_SOURCES})
add_library(Lua::Lua ALIAS lua)

target_include_directories(lua PUBLIC "${LUA_SOURCE_DIR}")
set_target_properties(lua PROPERTIES
  OUTPUT_NAME lua
  POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)

# OHOS is a POSIX/musl platform: enable the POSIX feature set but not the
# readline-based `LUA_USE_LINUX` convenience macro.
target_compile_definitions(lua PRIVATE LUA_USE_POSIX)

if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "OHOS" OR ANDROID)
  target_compile_definitions(lua PRIVATE LUA_USE_C89_DISABLED)
endif()

target_compile_options(lua PRIVATE -Wno-unused-parameter)

include(GNUInstallDirs)

# Lua 5.4 dropped the C++ wrapper header from the source distribution, but
# consumers such as fcitx5-lua include <lua.hpp>.  It is a four-line shim, so
# generate it rather than depending on a distribution package providing it.
file(WRITE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/lua.hpp"
"// C++ wrapper for the Lua headers, generated by the HarmonyOS port build.
// Lua 5.4 no longer ships this file.
extern \"C\" {
#include \"lua.h\"
#include \"lualib.h\"
#include \"lauxlib.h\"
}
")

# librime-lua discovers Lua through pkg-config (it looks for lua / lua54 / ...),
# and Lua's own distribution ships no .pc file, so generate one.
set(LUA_PC_VERSION "5.4.7")
configure_file("${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/lua.pc.in"
               "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/lua.pc" @ONLY)

install(TARGETS lua ARCHIVE DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}")
install(FILES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/lua.pc"
        DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/pkgconfig")
install(FILES
  "${LUA_SOURCE_DIR}/lua.h"
  "${LUA_SOURCE_DIR}/luaconf.h"
  "${LUA_SOURCE_DIR}/lualib.h"
  "${LUA_SOURCE_DIR}/lauxlib.h"
  "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/lua.hpp"
  DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}")
